inventory.notes: Performance fix (commit 26e54ca1b1): the Untrusted Modules processor skips the Authenticode lookup for this build's own unsigned binaries (beside firefox.exe and with its version), which always fell through to the catalog search: 1.26 s of CPU per launch. Classification unchanged (FirefoxDirectory + version). IsOwnUnsignedBinary is inline logic that can move to an own file.
